evidence.title: File:Liat Portal for Foodie Disorder - Majadra Style Peas with Carrots and Chicken.jpg
evidence.description:
High-quality photograph by Liat Portal showing a home-prepared plate of majadra-style peas cooked with carrots and onion in a tomato-based sauce, served alongside rice with lentils and a roasted chicken leg. This image documents a complete everyday lunch prepared without specialized tools or techniques, combining legumes, grains, and protein on a single plate.
 This image demonstrates cooking by time and sequencing rather than complexity, where components are prepared separately and assembled into a balanced meal.
